highlights: Jozapi fork：保住【】裡的文字。muse.ai 會把【…】當成引用標記刪掉，提示詞改用同形括號〖〗送出，回覆再換回【】（MUSE2API_PROTECT_BRACKETS=0 可關閉）。
Jozapi fork：修正對話回覆在 muse.ai 重新渲染時被重複輸出（截斷的一份 + 完整的一份），非串流請求改回傳最終文字，串流不再整段重送。
Jozapi fork：修正對話回覆早已寫完卻一直等到 chat_timeout（300 秒）才失敗。muse.ai 任務列表裡其他任務的「Stop task」按鈕不再被當成本輪仍在生成。
合入上游 1.6.10：修复发送按钮误匹配侧栏历史、Send feedback 或 Resend 的问题，避免参考图和长提示词留在输入框未提交。
合入上游 1.6.10：首次发送、重试和发送状态检查统一定位当前输入区域，识别中英文标签、disabled、aria-disabled 和 inert 状态。
合入上游 1.6.10：继续校验实际发送及媒体成品；点击发送不等于任务完成，不把上传的参考素材当生成结果。
合入上游 1.6.10：核验仓库、管理面板及中英文界面的社区推广内容清理状态；感谢 @WXJJ0520 的 PR #48。
合入上游 1.6.10：更新服务后请强制刷新管理页。插件仍为 1.0.2、油猴脚本仍为 1.1.2；当前版本无需重装，旧扩展仍需在各浏览器个人资料中手动升级。
更新檢測與一鍵／自動升級改為追蹤 Jozapi/muse2api（可用 MUSE2API_REPO 覆寫），避免升級時被上游覆蓋。
合入上游 1.6.8：管理介面改为全宽布局，新增保存前即时测试代理连通性。
合入上游 1.6.9：修复代理检测结果未回写的问题，测试后账号列表会更新为已连通、未通过或未测试，避免空记录被误标为未确认。
合入上游并发策略调整：image/video/chat 改为严格 LRU 轮转，账号池不再 sticky 15 次，默认并发数由 2 提升为 8。
合入上游 session keepalive 与管理页 UI 渲染优化；默认关闭静默自动升级并恢复管理页更新提示（横幅／徽章／通知），需设 MUSE2API_AUTO_UPGRADE=1 才启用上游那种后台静默自动升级。
修复 Muse 新版无 overlay/form 输入区的附件定位和确认，兼容旧版并排除历史聊天附件。
新增视频、音频、PDF/Word 参考素材：最多 10 个，单个 40 MiB、合计 100 MiB；MP4/MOV/3GP/WebM 必须含有效时长且不超过 120 秒。
混合素材提示词支持 [图N]/[视频N]/[音频N]/[文档N] 对照，避免强制第一张图片为起始帧而忽略视频参考。
修复原始参考素材误当成品、3 次过滤后提前失败、CDP 异常临时文件残留，以及 Snap Chromium 无法读取系统 /tmp 素材的问题。
浏览器插件继续使用 1.0.2、油猴脚本 1.1.2；仍使用旧插件的用户必须手动升级并重新加载，每个浏览器个人资料分别操作。
highlights_en: Jozapi fork: keep text inside 【】. muse.ai deletes 【…】 as citation markers; prompts now travel with look-alike brackets 〖〗 and replies get 【】 back (MUSE2API_PROTECT_BRACKETS=0 turns it off).

Jozapi fork: chat replies are no longer duplicated when muse.ai re-renders them (a cut-off copy followed by the full one). Non-streaming requests return the final text; streaming never resends the whole answer.

Jozapi fork: finished chat replies no longer wait for the full chat_timeout (300 s) and then fail. A "Stop task" button from another task in muse.ai's task list no longer counts as this reply still generating.
Merged upstream 1.6.10: Fix send-button matching against sidebar history, Send feedback and Resend, which could leave prompts and reference attachments unsubmitted.
Merged upstream 1.6.10: Initial sends, retries and readiness checks share one composer-scoped locator with localized labels and disabled, aria-disabled and inert handling.
Merged upstream 1.6.10: Keep actual submission and generated-media verification; clicking Send is not task completion, and uploaded references are not generated results.
Merged upstream 1.6.10: Verify repository and bilingual dashboard community-promotion cleanup. Thanks to @WXJJ0520 for PR #48.

Merged upstream 1.6.10: Hard-refresh after updating. Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; current versions need no reinstall. Older extensions require a manual update in every browser profile.
Update checks and one-click/auto upgrades follow Jozapi/muse2api (override with MUSE2API_REPO) so an upgrade cannot overwrite the fix.
Merged upstream 1.6.8: full-width admin layout plus instant proxy connectivity testing before saving.
Merged upstream 1.6.9: fixed the proxy-status regression so testing an account now updates its connectivity result (connected / failed / untested) instead of a stale unconfirmed state.
Merged upstream concurrency rework: image/video/chat picks now use strict LRU rotation instead of 15-call stickiness, with the default concurrency raised from 2 to 8.

Merged upstream session keepalive and admin UI rendering improvements; silent auto-upgrade is now off by default and the admin-page update banner/badge/toast are back, set MUSE2API_AUTO_UPGRADE=1 to opt into upstream's background silent auto-upgrade.
Fix attachment selection and confirmation for the new Muse composer without an overlay/form, retaining old-layout support and excluding chat history.
Add video, audio and PDF/Word references: up to 10 files, 40 MiB each, 100 MiB total. MP4/MOV/3GP/WebM require readable positive duration metadata of no more than 120 seconds.
Map mixed-reference markers to attachment order without forcing the first image to be the opening frame when video/audio references are present.
Fix uploaded references being returned as results, premature failure after three skipped references, temporary-file leaks after CDP errors, and Snap Chromium file access.
Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2. Users on older extensions must replace files and reload manually in every browser profile.
